title: The Kenya National Anthem
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: The anthem text is Kiswahili; questions give the lines in Kiswahili and ask for order and meaning in English. Practise standing at attention at assembly.

skills.key_step: The child orders the lines of the first stanza of the anthem in Kiswahili and says it is a prayer for blessings, justice, unity, peace and freedom.

floor.prerequisite: Names events where the anthem is sung (Grade 2).
floor.question: When do we sing the national anthem at school?

representations: the first stanza on a chart
steps: Say what each line asks for.

board.do: Write the six lines on the board, mixed up.

misconceptions.ask: Which line starts the first stanza of the Kenya National Anthem?
misconceptions.repair: Sing the stanza line by line and number the lines.

misconceptions.ask: What is the first stanza of the anthem about?
misconceptions.repair: Read the meaning of each line: baraka is blessing, amani is peace.

listen_for: live only with our own family
misconceptions.ask: In the anthem, "Natukae na undugu" asks us to...
misconceptions.repair: Ask: in the anthem, who are our brothers and sisters?

misconceptions.ask: What does "baraka" mean in "Ilete baraka kwetu"?
misconceptions.repair: Say each line and its meaning slowly, one at a time.

checks.question: Which line begins the first stanza?
What is the first stanza about?
checks.answer: a prayer for blessings, peace and unity

skills.key_step: The child names occasions when the flag is raised and the etiquette of the anthem.

floor.question: What do you do when the flag is raised?

representations: a picture of a flag raising
steps: Face the flag, hands at the sides.

board.do: Show a picture of Mashujaa Day.

misconceptions.ask: What do you do while the national anthem is sung?
misconceptions.repair: Practise stopping and standing still as soon as the anthem begins.

misconceptions.ask: Name an occasion other than school assembly when the flag is raised.
misconceptions.repair: Look at pictures of Jamhuri Day celebrations.

misconceptions.ask: A boy is wearing a cap when the anthem starts. What should he do?
misconceptions.repair: Show the class how to remove a cap and hold it at the side.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a day when the national flag is raised?
misconceptions.repair: Sort celebration cards into family and national.

checks.question: Name a national holiday when the flag is raised.
checks.answer: any of: Madaraka, Mashujaa, Jamhuri Day

checks.question: What do you do with your cap during the anthem?
